svg.title: TDS Taskmaster Task Card — Task 1: Bring the best red item from home
svg.desc: A Taskmaster-style aged parchment task card for Task 1 of the TDS Cup, instructing contestants to bring the best red item they own from home.
svg.text: You will have 1 minute to give your reason
for why your red item is the best.
